notes.title: Bloody Paws Unleashed has left Early Access!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 is here! With a plethora of updates and additions since the last update - I think you'll enjoy it!
Please let me know of any bugs or issues you may encounter, there's always room for improvement.
Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Bloody Paws Unleashed leaves Early Access October 14th!
notes.notes:
That's right! [b]Bloody Paws Unleashed finally leaves Early Access October 14th[/b]! Just in time for Halloween! 

Thank you for all of your support and feedback during this time. If you've already played the Early Access version of this game, here's what awaits you next weekend:

[b]MAIN ADDITIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed game to Bloody Paws Unleashed, created new logo
[*] New highway stage
[*] 2 new bosses
[*] New cutscenes between levels, featuring brand new art and animation
[/list]

[b]VISUALS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added various new sprite animations and embellishments (flash, explosions, power ups, others)
[*] New HUD
[*] Updated animations for Bloody
[*] Updated animations for invisible men
[*] Updated animations for witch
[*] Updated animations for skaters
[*] Updated animations for Frankie (on skates and final fight)
[*] Added mist to village stage
[*] New Game Over screen
[*] Removed “resist the attack” note
[*] Wanted posters in Downtown stage have been translated for their respective language modes
[/list]

[b]CONTROLS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new jump attack (down+attack)
[*] Added double jump for power-up level #2
[*] Power-up level #2 can now perform grabs and up+attack
[*] Improved grabs
[*] More control over jumps
[*] Hurricane attack is now a special attack, with designated button (consumes mp)
[/list]

[b]ENEMY TWEAKS[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked zombie: no hurt on contact, attack animation added
[*] Updated pattern of skating Frankie. Has lower HP.
[*] Skull pile turrets have less HP
[*] Improved car crash (now found only in Plaza stage). Car is vulnerable before crash.
[/list]

[b]TIMER[/b]
[list]
[*] New clock timer item
[*] Fixed clock resetting after clearing group of enemies
[*] Timer stops when completing level
[/list]

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] New hurricane item (for special attack)
[*] Village stage is now part of Forest stage
[*] Rearranged later “resist the attack” segments
[*] Added short voice clips
[*] Updated sounds and music in bonus stage
[/list]

notes.title: Full version coming soon!
notes.notes: Work is underway for the next update! Since the release of v0.3.3, I've been able to add many teaks, and much more. New bosses, new stages, new music tracks! The coolest part? This next release will be, finally, the full version of Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed v1.0! Coming soon!

notes.title: New Bosses!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.3.3!!!
Three new bosses have been added to the game, and the fight with Frankie has been tweaked and improved! Plus more!

What's new:
- Added boss fight against Death, at the end of stage 2 (graveyard)
- Improved boss fight against Frankie (on skates), including a new castle room for the fight. This constitutes the first boss fight at the castle (last level)
- New boss fight against evil Bloody, happens after defeating Frankie (on skates)
- Added new boss fight on Castle's roof, against Frankie (round 2) and his deathly machines of death
- Added new enemy: car driven by drunk guy. Found on stages 1 (Downtown) and 3 (Plaza)
- Plus other adjustments and polish

notes.title: Brand new stage!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.3.2!!!
A brand new stage has been added to the game: the inside of the castle! This stage was not a part of the original 1990 game, and its exclusive to Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed. It acts as the last level of the game, and consists of two sub-levels.

Other notable updates:
- Witches and invisible men can only hurt you during their attacks, not by merely walking into you.
- Shuffled stage order: now the first "resist the attack" scene ("avoid the balls") takes place in stage 3
- Added detail in backgrounds of level 1
- Tweaked/updated movement of witch
- Fixed scroll glitch in stages The Village and The Gargoyles

Frankie is sitting this one out and will return in the next update!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.3.1!!!
A new enemy, the witch, has been added to the game! The witch was originally meant to be included in the original Bloody Paws game back in 1990, but wasn't due to memory limitations. Thanks to the original sketches found by Juan Carlos, the witch has been finally included in Bloody Paws, over 30 years later!! She retains all the moves that she would have had in the original release. In this remake, you can find her in The Village stage.

Other notable updates:
- Bloody's basic combo has been upgraded and now includes a new attack: a Double Lariat!
- The bonus stage now has a brand new music track
- Bloody's "bullet" has a shorter reach
- Added more detail to background in stage 1

notes.title: Bonus stage!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.3.0!!! 
Test your reflexes in the new "Love Tester" bonus stage, and earn extra lives! 
Other updates:
- New "time over" animation
- Ghosts take a bit longer to recover from a hit, making them easier to dodge
- Jump higher when powered up (level 2)
- The Sun starts to rise as you progress through the levels

notes.title: New Classic Mode!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.2.9!!! 
Includes a new game mode - Classic! Graphics, sounds, gameplay mechanics, stage length and order vary to more closely reflect the original ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions of Bloody Paws! (Thanks ThλtGenericPyro for the suggestion!)

notes.title: New boss fight, plus power-ups!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.2.7!!!
- New boss fight in stage 1-3
- New power-up! Pick up a photo of Samantha while powered up, and get the ability to shoot projectiles as a main attack
- Now you get to keep your powers after completing a stage
- Improved Save feature: progress is saved when reaching a new stage

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: New cutscenes and language modes!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.2.6!!!
- New cutscenes! Now all text between levels are accompanied by beautiful illustrations
- Languages available: English, Spanish, and German!
- Tweaked stage 1-2 ("resist the attack") by decreasing its difficulty.

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Power Up, plus a couple of tweaks!
notes.notes:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed version 0.2.5 is here, with the following updates:

- New Power up: pick up photos of your beloved Samantha Wolf and upgrade to faster attacks with longer reach! (Thanks [i]oldmanwinters[/i] for the suggestion!)
- Fixed music/saving issue (thanks [i]vex[/i]!) 
- Added the text "avoid the balls" at the start of the first "resist the attack" stage (Thanks [i]oldmanwinters [/i]and [i]Noel[/i]!)

notes.title: Version 0.2.4 Live Now!
notes.notes:
Be among the first people to play Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed! Get a taste of the game early and experience first-hand the development process of this remake :) 

At this point, the original 1990 ZX Spectrum /Amstrad CPC game has been remade in its entirety (with extras!), and you can give it a try before any additional content is included (expanded levels and boss battles being the main thing)

notes.title: Early Access releases tomorrow April 27!
notes.notes:
Alright guys, Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed will be available as EA starting tomorrow Tuesday, April 27! At this point, the original 1990 ZX Spectrum /Amstrad CPC game has been remade in its entirety (with extras!), and you can give it a try before any additional content is included (expanded levels and boss battles being the main thing)
Also! I uploaded a new gameplay video that shows the already expanded Graveyard stage, with a second section involving some minor platforming to add a bit of variety. 
Have a great day and see you tomorrow!
